children: FactSet Research Systems entered into an amendment to its credit agreement to extend and enhance its senior unsecured facilities. The term loan maturity moves to Aug. 28, 2029, while the revolving credit facility increases to $1.5 billion and extends to Aug. 28, 2031. The amendment also removes the 0.10% credit spread adjustment on SONIA and SOFR borrowings and eliminates term loan amortization, improving flexibility and lowering borrowing spreads.
: Amendment to senior unsecured term loan and revolving credit facilities
: PNC Bank, as administrative agent, and other lenders
: Term loan matures Aug 28 2029; revolver matures Aug 28 2031
: Extend maturities and enhance liquidity and flexibility
